description:
This file defines the AutoParagraph injector class for HTMLPurifier, which automatically inserts

tags around text blocks based on double line breaks, to enhance HTML formatting.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_AutoParagraph
classes.description:
An injector class that automatically inserts paragraph tags (

) into HTML content where double line breaks are detected, based on double-spacing in text.

methods.name: _pStart
methods.description:
Creates and returns a new start token for a

element with error handling for well-formedness.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description:
Processes text tokens to determine if

tags should be inserted based on double newlines and other conditions.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description:
Handles element tokens, inserting

tags where inline elements or block elements require paragraph wrapping.

methods.name: _splitText
methods.description: Splits a block of text into multiple paragraph tokens based on double newlines, and manages start/end paragraph tags accordingly.

methods.name: _isInline
methods.description: Determines if a token represents an inline element suitable for paragraph formatting.

methods.name: _pLookAhead
methods.description:
Previews upcoming tokens to decide if a

tag should be inserted.

methods.name: _checkNeedsP
methods.description: Checks whether a token requires an inline paragraph tag to be inserted before it.
